question: In 2025, to which of the following outstanding shooters was the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award presented by the President of India, Droupadi Murmu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manu Bhaker**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Manu Bhaker** was conferred with the prestigious **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** in **2025** by the President of India, **Droupadi Murmu**, at **Rashtrapati Bhavan**.
 
• This award recognized her historic performance at the **Paris 2024 Olympics**, where she became the first athlete from independent India to win **two medals** in a single edition of the **Olympic Games**.
 
• She secured a **Bronze medal** in the **Women’s 10m Air Pistol** event and another **Bronze medal** in the **10m Air Pistol Mixed Team** event along with **Sarabjot Singh**.
 
• The **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna** is the highest sporting honor in India, awarded annually by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** for spectacular performance over a period of **four years**.
